note: PROPOSAL (RH-4a): the closed rehearsal.r3.* list for R3 A-vs-B digests. It is NOT merged into compare/masks.json; Codex reviews it first. A mask names exact JSON field names (or the ROOT path rewrite) and nothing else. Owners, generations, attempts, leases, statuses, authorization results, digests and refs are never masked (r3.validate_masks refuses such a field).

masks.reason: the wall-clock time at which decision-feedback status/report builds its projection (DecisionFeedback.status/report: generated_at = self.clock())

a duration computed from the wall clock at read time (domain/audit_progress.py status view: elapsed_seconds, shown by audit-service status); stored timestamps are identical on A and B over one copy and are not masked
the OS pid of a writer process in the observation health records (domain/observation.py: source pid), shown by observe status process_health
the per-run scratch ROOT (and ROOT/X) path in plain text is rewritten to <ROOT>; it differs per run, never between A and B
